short_caption: Bedroom wall with desk, monitor, white keyboard, window, mini fridge.
literal_description: A light laminate desk on the left holds a curved monitor, mechanical keyboard, glowing mouse, black cylindrical speaker, and a white gamepad on a black-and-white patterned desk mat. A white digital piano keyboard sits on a black X stand to the right of the desk. Above, a hand-painted poster of a yellow-haired anime character with Hebrew text and a poster of a white-haired anime fighter with orange flames hang on the white wall. An aluminum casement window with a white roller shutter is open on the right. A white mini fridge stands under the window corner and a navy-covered single bed occupies the right edge. A gray step platform is under the desk and black cables, adapters, and a teal power strip lie on the beige tile floor.
environment: Small residential bedroom, roughly 3 m by 3 m, with white painted plaster walls, beige square ceramic floor tiles with a matching tile skirting strip, an aluminum-framed casement window with a white roller shutter, and a wood-veneer interior door.
lighting: Even overhead artificial ceiling light, neutral white color temperature, low contrast, soft short shadows under furniture; no direct sunlight through the window.
atmosphere: Clear indoor air with no visible fog, smoke, dust, or haze.
ambient_sound: Quiet small-room tone with the low hum of a mini fridge compressor and a soft computer fan whir.
